During the [[Clone Wars]], a '''B1-series battle droid''' served within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], under the command of [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]] [[TM-171]].<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> In [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[B1-series battle droid|battle droid]] participated in a multi-[[Standard day|day]] [[Battle of Umbara|campaign]] that took place on the [[planet]] [[Umbara]], after it had seceded from the [[Galactic Republic]] to the Confederacy during the war, which led to the planet's invasion by the Republic. Aboard the [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]] of TM-171, the B1 battle droid assisted the [[tactical droid]] in strategic resupplying operations<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> throughout the campaign, but was later destroyed following the destruction of the [[supply ship]] in [[orbit]].<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />
